_doc: #798 what the pinned detect classifier (data/models.json::models.detect) must answer for the golden images here, checked against the REAL model through LiteRT's runtime by lib-apks/test/test-ml-goldens.sh. grace_hopper.jpg is the US Navy portrait of Commodore Grace M. Hopper (public domain, a work of the US federal government; File source: http://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Grace_Hopper.jpg, the copy TensorFlow's own label_image example uses). The image is resized to the model's input, as ML Kit does for each detected object's crop.
